ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_scale_invariant_delta_rank_v1
ir.intuition: Repaired missing 'advantage_gap' signal by replacing it with 'delta_rank', which is available and also reflects objective-related ranking difference between winner and loser. This maintains scale-invariance and ensures gradients remain sensitive to objective signals. Kept the same structure of normalizing margin by sequence length difference and sum aggregation.
ir.pseudocode:
seq_len_diff = abs(seq_len_w - seq_len_l) if available else 1
eps = 1e-6
margin = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (seq_len_diff + eps)
augment = delta_rank * delta_rank_scale
x = alpha * scale * margin + augment
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
if weight present:
  loss = loss * weight
loss = sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    seq_len_w = batch.get('seq_len_w', None)
    seq_len_l = batch.get('seq_len_l', None)
    if seq_len_w is not None and seq_len_l is not None:
        seq_len_diff = ops.abs(ops.sub(seq_len_w, seq_len_l))
    else:
        seq_len_diff = lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))
    delta_rank_scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('delta_rank_scale', 1.0))
    margin = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.add(seq_len_diff, eps))
    augment = ops.mul(delta_rank_scale, delta_rank)
    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, margin), augment)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
